description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Monk Mode I (Zell)] and [Monk Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Monk Mode I (Zell)
description.text: Monk abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Monk abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Monk abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Monk abilities, casts Dual Heat Punch after casting three equipped Monk abilities (max 1)

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Monk Mode II (Zell)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Monk Mode I (Zell)] from the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Monk Mode II (Zell)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Monk abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Monk abilities trigger 1 additional time, critical chance =100%, instant cast speed for Monk abilities

description.name: Dual Heat Punch
description.text: One single attack (4.76/5.27/5.81) capped at 99999 if the user dealt 0/72001/240001+ damage while under [Dual Awoken Monk Mode I (Zell)], 100% hit rate, grants [100% Critical 3] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3
